nodes.text: 1/4 China is currently dealing with an outbreak of the human metapneumovirus (HMPV), which is known to cause symptoms similar to both the flu and COVID-19. nodes.text: elderly, leading to overwhelmed healthcare facilities in some areas. The symptoms of HMPV include coughing, fever, nasal congestion, shortness of breath, and in severe cases, it can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia. There is no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine available

nodes.text: for HMPV, so management typically involves supportive care to alleviate symptoms. Health officials in China have recommended measures such as wearing masks, frequent hand washing, and avoiding close contact with sick individuals to curb the spread of the virus. The situation has
